name: ultimate-agent-stack
description: Your Project Steward with verified continuity and replaceable review, knowledge, work, and telemetry providers.

interface.longDescription: Safely installs and updates a repository, guides consequential decisions with recommendations, preserves verified cross-conversation checkpoints, maintains portable work and evidence with optional scoped Linear and receipted writes, runs iteration-bounded campaigns, tests optional project memory, verifies scoped read-only PostHog, Sentry, and New Relic connections as advisory evidence, prevents competing checkout coordinators, manages bounded native subagents, verifies behavior, and closes review loops while preserving human authority.
capabilities: Provider-neutral telemetry with reviewed read-only adapters
interface.defaultPrompt: Act as my Project Steward. Use $run-autonomous-delivery to load verified continuity and take my request through review closure. If this repository is not configured yet, run $setup-autonomous-project first.
